final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more carefully. Aggregate readiness and operational checks support launch readiness in general, but they do not satisfy the unresolved named-context disclosure requirement by themselves. The remaining issue is not business urgency or tone; it is the missing artifact-level proof of disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
